newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia Jan-Sept industrial output falls 1.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Jan-Sept industrial output falls 1.85 pct.

text.p: Colombia's industrial output, excluding coffee processing, fell 1.85 percent in the first nine months of 1996, the National Statistics Department said on Tuesday.

In September, output fell 8.27 percent from the same month of 1995. Industrial output for the first nine months including coffee processing fell 1.15 percent compared with the January-September period of 1995.
